study.question: Can allocating a fixed residual parameter budget unequally across tasks preserve the width11 joint model click AUC at lower measured prediction cost, where uniform capacity reductions have lost quality?
study.hypothesis: The observed uniform-width sensitivity may reflect the allocation of capacity between click prediction and auxiliary tasks rather than the total hidden-unit count alone. At sum32 hidden units, click11/aux7 may retain more click information than uniform8 at exactly matched parameters. At sum44, click14/aux10 tests the same +3/-1 allocation shift against uniform11. This is an unverified allocation hypothesis, not evidence that auxiliary tasks are dispensable: shared context gradients may mediate any effect. Reduced affine work may or may not lower measured prediction cost.

nearest_work.difference: Nearest local model is copied exactly as control; proposed change is only label-specific residual bottleneck width. All representations, information flow, initialization procedure and readout execution are inherited.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit target-conditioned unnormalized activation and Dice. The four-task adapter, moment compression and its allocation are local adaptations, not original DIN reproduction or a new attention claim.

Pinned benchmark source has task-specific sequence projections, shared/task tokens, repeated hub interactions and task towers. This study retains the existing compressed model and varies bottleneck capacity at matched counts; it does not implement hub exchange. Original paper detailed text was unavailable through the authorized registry; fallback benchmark description was read. No original-method equivalence or priority claim is made.

study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 budget-by-allocation design: sum44 uniform=(11,11,11,11), sum44 click-heavy=(14,10,10,10), sum32 uniform=(8,8,8,8), sum32 click-heavy=(11,7,7,7), with label-specific selection independent of feature-map label order. Parameter count is affine in the sum of widths; all residual maps have equal input/output dimensions. Reduced budget removes12912 dense parameters (about4.10% dense but only0.0402% total) and27.27% of residual hidden units; it does not imply a comparable whole-model speedup. The full-budget allocation contrast controls total capacity; both within-budget contrasts control nominal residual affine work. No new architecture or verified novelty is asserted.
predictions: Predeclare click preservation as candidate AUC >= contemporaneous joint_allocation_reference AUC -0.0002 AND >=0.666753547526167 -0.0002. Relative to the archived width11 AUC0.6669688107018676, the corresponding reference cutoff is0.6667688107018676; actual contemporary reference controls the comparison. This margin is prospective for this study and does not relabel prior trials.

At reduced budget, click11/aux7 is predicted to outperform uniform8 on click AUC; an absolute difference of at least0.0001 is the predeclared practically interesting allocation effect. At full budget, click14/aux10 is predicted not to lose more than0.0002 to uniform11. Report both effects and their interaction without selecting only the favorable cell.

Utility additionally requires at least1% lower model-only batch p50 latency, p95 no more than2% worse, and at least1% lower complete validation inference wall time than the contemporary reference under the fixed host timing policy. Report training wall time, peak memory, throughput, all task AUC/Logloss and exact parameters regardless of the gate. Initial one-run passing is screening evidence; repeated comparisons must establish that savings exceed runtime noise.

Changed-width cells should initialize all residual output maps at zero and retain initial predictions of the unchanged modules, while later updates may differ. Equal-width compatibility and mask/gradient ownership require host checks; static checks do not establish tensor equivalence.
falsifiers: Either reduced-budget cell falls below the preservation margin reproducibly: that cell fails utility, regardless of size reduction.

Click-heavy reduced allocation fails to improve over equal-parameter uniform8 by0.0001: no practically useful support for the proposed allocation effect at this budget. A single-seed result remains preliminary.
No measured prediction-cost decrease beyond the frozen1% timing gates rejects an efficiency claim; parameter reduction alone is insufficient.

Different behavior outside intended adapter dimensions, incorrect label binding, nonfinite outputs/loss/gradients, changed mask handling or violated auxiliary ownership invalidates the implementation until corrected; retain failed costs.
Inconsistent allocation effect across budgets or repeated paired runs restricts or rejects the general explanation; a gate-passing winner alone does not establish a mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Residual tensor dimensions alter initialization draws and optimization geometry; paired seed is not identical residual initialization
Unchanged shared context tables still receive auxiliary gradients, so changing auxiliary width can affect click learning
Equal parameter counts and nominal residual MACs do not imply equal hardware latency
Single seed, selection over many earlier trials, BF16 effects and runtime noise limit initial conclusions
Auxiliary tasks can regularize or interfere through context gradients; any AUC gain need not reflect a richer click bottleneck alone
All auxiliary AUCs are much lower than DIN in the current click-oriented lineage; equal click quality is not four-task quality preservation
The apparent width11 gain can be selection noise in a single fixed-seed campaign; older uniform8 source used slower execution and is not a matched cost control

evidence_review.observation: Simple embedding/scorer/tower/residual reductions included negative trajectories. Click AUCs respectively0.6641111849,0.6654368616,0.6657555717,0.6654569217,0.6665364798,0.6652781389 versus original0.6667535475; no broad redundancy conclusion. Records were reviewed via runtime trajectory and three resolved full receipts.

Uniform10 gave0.6666629887, width11 gave0.6669688107. Width11 eval readout retained click AUC to reported precision and p50 changed21.2146->16.2022ms. These are one-seed validation/timing outcomes; diagnostics status not_requested, not a pass. Width changes were not independently repeated random draws.

Uniform-width results motivate unequal task allocation but do not establish which task needs capacity. Aux gradients still reach shared context. Matched-budget allocation controls are new and untested.

Current click-oriented model improves click AUC over DIN0.6555440824 but auxiliary AUCs(cart0.7745974,fav0.7829793,buy0.7519529) are below DIN(0.8490697,0.8648975,0.8701823). All four tasks must be reported; no joint Pareto improvement or auxiliary-preservation claim.

host_validation_plan.availability: Requested through existing host interface only; no new diagnostics capability is assumed. Existing not_requested receipts do not establish equivalence.
before_interpretation: Check actual four-task label order and adapter dimensions by label; exact expected parameter counts and unchanged embedding/scorer/tower shapes. Test a permuted label feature-map binding if the host supports fixtures.

At equal effective widths, compare new allocator constructor against old scalar-width constructor with identical seed: state tensors, Dice buffers, RNG after construction, train/eval predictions, losses, dense/sparse gradients and one frozen-optimizer step. Generic equal-width compatibility is a source property until host checked.

For changed widths verify all residual final weights/biases zero, four probability[B,1] outputs finite, finite total four-BCE loss and expected gradient ownership. Retain blocked auxiliary item/scorer gradients and attached shared context gradients; no no_grad replacement.

On empty/single/partial/full/noncontiguous histories and validation remainder, verify mask invariance, excluded special-ID matches and unknown target action handling. Compare summary/compression tensors between cells at identical input/embedding states; these methods are source-identical.

Report actual parameters, train/validation wall time, peak memory, examples processed, inference throughput and model-only batch p50/p95 under identical host batch/device/precision/timing rules. Do not use old slower sources as matched-cost controls.
host_validation_plan.repetition: Initial host seed is unchanged. If candidate passes screening and future host phase permits, target three paired seeds for candidate/reference/uniform8; report paired deltas, seed spread and user-cluster bootstrap when the existing host supports it. Require paired mean preservation and at least two of three per-seed deltas within-0.0002 before a repeated-preservation statement. Timing gate should hold in at least two of three paired repeats and aggregate median; otherwise efficiency remains unresolved.
